title.narrative: National CFC Phase-out Plan: 2006 Work Programme

description.narrative: The national phase-out plan aims to phase-out the total remaining CFC consumption estimated at 2,429.5 ODP tonnes in 2003 (without CFC consumption in the metered dose inhaler (MDI) sector). The estimated consumption in 2003 was taken as a basis in formulating the CFC reduction schedule in the Agreement starting from 2004 onward.
